notes: slug=null lets the kaggle service runner (external/kaggle/service.py) derive the kernel slug: the model name for train, <model>-<notebook> otherwise. Set it to pin an explicit slug.
Bare dataset/kernel slugs get the authenticated Kaggle username prefixed by the kaggle service runner (external/kaggle/service.py).
kernel_sources mounts the sportsmot-train-download kernel's OUTPUT (sportsmot-train.tar, the pre-staged training data); the launcher refuses to push while that kernel is not COMPLETE.
external-secrets (listed in dataset_sources) carries HF_TOKEN — Kaggle Secrets are dropped on CLI pushes while dataset references survive. The runner warns if no external-secrets dataset is listed.

machine_shape: NvidiaTeslaP100 — UNUSABLE: Kaggle's torch ships no sm_60 kernels ('no kernel image is available for execution on the device')
available_options_reference.enable_gpu: bool — with no machine_shape the API assigns the default GPU, the unusable P100; always pin machine_shape for GPU runs
available_options_reference.enable_internet: bool — needed to reach the Hugging Face Hub
available_options_reference.kernel_sources: list of <owner>/<kernel-slug> whose OUTPUT files are mounted under /kaggle/input
available_options_reference.timeout: kaggle kernels push -t <seconds> caps the run length
available_options_reference.is_private: bool — private kernels are the workspace default
available_options_reference.timeout_seconds: top-level; caps the run length (kernels_push timeout); null -> Kaggle default
